name: trace-waterfall
description: A live waterfall of each turn in a side pane: every model call, tool call and subagent as a bar on one time axis, with duration and estimated cost

start.title: Open at start
start.description: on: the Trace pane opens when a session starts; in the terminal it shows once the window is at least 144 columns wide. off: it stays closed until you run /trace-waterfall.
